name: High Volume of Unique Subdomains for One Parent Domain (Possible DNS Tunneling / DGA)
description: A single internal host resolves an unusually high number of distinct subdomains under one registered domain in a short window — the signature of DNS tunneling for C2/exfil, or algorithmically generated domains.
false_positives: CDNs, telemetry, and anti-spam services that legitimately use many subdomains (allow-list the registered domain).
Corporate DNS resolvers aggregating many clients (exclude the resolver IP).
note:
### Triage
- Look at `dns.question.registered_domain` — recognisable service or random-looking?
- Inspect subdomain length/entropy and whether TXT/NULL record types are used.
- Identify the process on `source.ip` from host telemetry.
